headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: All-Star Game and Roster Moves**
article:
The American League All-Stars dominated the National League All-Stars in the Midsummer Classic, securing a 4-0 victory. Dylan Cease earned the win for the American League All-Stars. The Boston Red Sox made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's availability. Nick Mears, a right-handed pitcher for the Kansas City Royals, has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement. Other players on the injured list include Keegan Akin of the Baltimore Orioles, Zac Gallen of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Chris Martin of the Texas Rangers, Nick Lodolo of the Cincinnati Reds, William Kempner of the Miami Marlins, Brandon Woodruff of the Milwaukee Brewers, and Mike Yastrzemski of the Atlanta Braves.

In addition to the injury updates, several trades and roster moves have been made. The Boston Red Sox acquired outfielder Jahmai Jones in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The Kansas City Royals acquired right-handed pitcher Easton McGee from the Milwaukee Brewers for cash. The Baltimore Orioles acquired right-handed pitcher Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers acquired shortstop Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox traded left-handed pitcher Brandon Eisert and first baseman Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for left-handed pitcher Jaden Woods and future considerations.
